title: Evaluation datasets of retrieval-augmented generation papers
definition: Each dataset on which at least one corpus paper evaluates a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) method, with the papers that report results on it.

scope.papers: corpus papers that propose or evaluate a method in which retrieved passages are given to a language model that generates the output
scope.datasets: datasets with reported results (tables or text) in those papers; datasets only cited or only used for training do not count

competency_questions: Which datasets does a given RAG paper report results on?
How many corpus papers evaluate a RAG method on Natural Questions?
Are name variants of one dataset (NQ, Natural Questions, NaturalQuestions) counted as one dataset?
needs: which papers propose or evaluate a RAG method
